programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.title: The Notebook

programme.title: Blended

programme.title: No Strings Attached

programme.title: She's Out of My League

programme.title: Last Christmas

programme.desc: Detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of a demonic serial killer, Edgar Reese. However, questions arise when the murders start again, eerily matching the modus operandi of Reese.
programme.title: Fallen

programme.desc: Kaya is a Buddhist girl who must find a young boy considered to be the reincarnation of their teacher. However, the boy witnesses a murder, which makes his return to the monastery difficult.
programme.title: Paap

programme.desc: Two gangsters working for politicians from opposite parties believe that their respective leaders will provide a better future. The two are pitted against each other when the politicians unite.
programme.title: Taaqat

programme.desc: Born out of an illicit relationship and nurtured by a drunkard, a man wonders about his identity. Luck favours him when he unknowingly crosses paths with his biological father.
programme.title: Laawaris

programme.desc: Laila, a cabaret dancer who grew up in a brothel, gets a call from her dying mother divulging that she was adopted. So, she takes the help of her lover, Karan, in finding out who her real parents are.
programme.title: Dil Aashna Hai

programme.desc: Ganga, an innocent man, is raised by a foster couple in a village. When he is brought back to his family in the city, he struggles to fit into modern society.
programme.title: Jis Desh Mein Ganga Rehta Hain

programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.
programme.title: Mela

programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside down when his father is killed by a general, whom he swears revenge against.
programme.title: Sultanat

programme.desc: Chandan, a farmer's nephew, is in love with Gunja, his sister-in-law's sibling. However, when her sister dies in an accident, Gunja is expected to marry Chandan's brother.
programme.title: Nadiya Ke Paar

programme.desc: Happy, notoriously famous for his antics, is sent to fetch Lakhan so that he can meet his ailing father. But, in Australia, Happy ends up taking Lakhan's place as the king of the local underworld.
programme.title: Singh Is Kinng

programme.desc: Three friends, orphaned by an evil man, set out to take revenge for their father's murders. They are forced to navigate a complex web of deceit and stolen identities before they can reach their goal.
programme.title: Roop Ki Rani Choron Ka Raja

programme.desc: In Mumbai for a wedding, a married man contemplates an affair with a sexy starlet who has an ulterior motive for flirting with him.
programme.title: Grudgudee

programme.desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth fall in love with each other. However, things take a dangerous turn when Ganpat, her brother, does not favour their relationship and plans to kill Siddharth.
programme.title: Run

programme.desc: Ravi, an unemployed man who constantly gets into fights, is framed for the murder of a gangster. With no support from his family, he must now fight to prove his innocence.
programme.title: Loafer

programme.desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love with each other without ever meeting each other. Later, Aarti sets out to look for him in the city of Delhi.
programme.title: Sirf Tum

programme.desc: Vijay, a factory supervisor, is falsely accused and arrested for killing his family. Just when he is at his lowest point, an inspector offers to help him in return for capturing the son of a gangster.
programme.title: Aadmi

programme.desc: A man returns to his city to save his lover and settle old scores with her cruel father.
programme.title: Tezaab

programme.desc: Kicha is a modern-day Robin Hood, who along with his friend, Mani, steals from the rich to aid the poor. In society, he is a respected man who runs a small business.
programme.title: Gentleman

programme.desc: Satyadev Singh, who leads a happy life with his wife and two sons, is killed by a corrupt collector, Bhim Singh. Years later, his sons, Sham and Ghansham, set out to avenge their father.
programme.title: Sham Ghansham

programme.desc: An investigative TV journalist and her cameraman set off to look into a tribal uprising and interview the leader. Before their journey ends, they find themselves falling in love with each other.
programme.title: Do Rahain

programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer with a vendetta charms a businessman's elder daughter and then kills her in a way that would make it seem like a case of suicide. He then plots to destroy the rest of the family.
programme.title: Baazigar

programme.desc: Jagjinder Joginder, a wedding planner, brings together the dysfunctional family of businessman Bipin Arora while making arrangements for his daughter's destination wedding in London.
programme.title: Shaandaar

programme.desc: Raj and Priya, a married couple, hire Madhubala, a prostitute, as the surrogate mother of their child. Trouble brews when Madhubala falls in love with Raj and insists on keeping the child.
programme.title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke

programme.desc: A top cop hires a man to guard his grandchild, unaware of the lurking threat. However, this protector is a hitman sent by kin to bump off the successor and grab the hefty estate.
programme.title: Jaan

programme.desc: When Ganga's husband abandons her, she embarks on a journey to Calcutta to find him and ensure her son has a better future. But she is cheated and forced to work in a brothel.
programme.title: Ram Teri Ganga Maili

programme.desc: When a criminal is sentenced to death by Judge Saxena, the gangster's brother takes revenge by killing the judge's family and his driver. Later, the driver's son embarks on a vengeful quest.
programme.title: Vijaypath

programme.desc: Mamta runs away with her son Vishwas to avoid any sort of contact with her criminal husband. Years later, Vishwas is unknowingly employed by his own father.
programme.title: Hum Pyar Tumhi Se Kar Baithe

programme.desc: Sweety runs away from her home to Seychelles in hopes of finding her father. However, things take a turn when she finds out that her father is staying there with another woman.
programme.title: Papa Kahte Hain

programme.desc: A group of four friends decide to play a prank involving the fake kidnapping of one of them and asking for ransom from her father. However, things become complicated when she actually ends up dead.
programme.title: Khiladi

programme.desc: Enraged by the police's indifference to his sister's murder, Bahadur becomes a dacoit to take the law into his own hands. He mistakenly kills a doctor, whose son swears to avenge his death.
programme.title: Aag Hi Aag

programme.desc: Avatar leads a happy life with his wife, Radha, and his sons, Chander and Ramesh. However, consumed by their greed and ambitions, Avatar's sons betray him, but he soon reaches new heights of success.
programme.title: Avtaar

programme.desc: After being mercilessly beaten and abandoned to die, a young man is rescued by a band of dacoits, who nurse him back to health in their hidden lair.
programme.title: Dacait

programme.desc: Brigadier Suryadev Singh and Shivajirao Waghle, a police inspector, work together to track down a terrorist who plans to evade India.
programme.title: Tirangaa

programme.desc: Singh Saab is a responsible tax collector who believes in honesty, but Bhoodev, a conniving man, plots against him. Singh adopts a unique way to teach Bhoodev a lesson.
programme.title: Singh Saab the Great

programme.desc: After Vijay, a young army cadet, finds evidence against the corrupt officer, Gautam, he gets entangled in a never-ending battle with the police, which puts his career and his family in trouble.
programme.title: Salaami

programme.desc: To usurp the property from its ailing patriarch, a family hatches a plan and brings home an imposter as the lost grandson. However, the young man has plans of his own.
programme.title: Laalchee

programme.desc: Balwant, a truck driver, is driven into the underworld as he wants to take revenge on the owners of the trucking company for the death of his brother.
programme.title: Khatron Ke Khiladi

programme.desc: Inspector Jai balances working as a cop with taking care of his mother and a brother with developmental disabilities. But when he arrests a local don, he starts to fear for his family's safety.
programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara

programme.desc: Henna, a bubbly young woman based in a village in Pakistan, sets her heart on an endearing stranger who winds up there with serious injuries and no memory of his past.
programme.title: Henna

programme.desc: Twin sisters who are separated at birth, cause chaos when they swap places.
programme.title: Seeta Aur Geeta

programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.
programme.title: Ghatak

programme.desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest police officer, is tasked with curbing Tezpur's rampant crime rates. Here he must work with his fellow corrupt officers and deal with the town's insidious political figures.
programme.title: Gangaajal

programme.desc: Three friends, orphaned by an evil man, set out to take revenge for their father's murders. They are forced to navigate a complex web of deceit and stolen identities before they can reach their goal.
programme.title: Roop Ki Rani Choron Ka Raja

programme.desc: Maddy has seven days to win Reena's affections before she finds out that he is not Rajeev, the childhood friend and prospective fiancé she has been expecting.
